meta.title: Multi-Currency Intake: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Set or verify that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.
Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and test Multi-Currency Intake access.
Repeat the same test as a Requester / End User and compare availability.
Open Multi-Currency Intake and inspect or obtain intake templates for multiple currencies.
Determine whether any refusal or absence is caused by deliberate tenant RBAC configuration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Set or verify that the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.; Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and test Multi-Currency Intake access.; Repeat the same test as a Requester / End User and compare availability.; Open Multi-Currency Intake and inspect or obtain intake templates for multiple currencies.; Determine whether any refusal or absence is caused by deliberate tenant RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in as the configured non-Requester user and as a Requester / End User on the Enterprise tenant, open Multi-Currency Intake, compare whether multi-currency intake templates are refused or available, and record any RBAC configuration explanation

steps.note: No catalog step can switch to the specified user roles, verify the plan, or reach Multi-Currency Intake.
Check that the final screen used for the tester's comparison has no crash, server error, undefined values, or raw identifiers.
